answer:
Of the 16 items listed, only one never appears in the pilot run: the **facebook/wav2vec2-base** representation, which is marked exploratory [rep-wav2vec2]. Every other listed condition, control, environment, pooling method, probe, representation and task includes run-pilot among its users [cond-joint] [cond-random] [cond-speaker] [cond-word] [ctrl-lookup] [env-flap] [pool-max] [pool-mean] [pool-midpoint] [probe-linear] [rep-mfcc] [rep-wavjepa] [task-control] [task-speaker] [task-voicing].

wav2vec2-base is not entirely unused. It was run in the representation-communities run and the span grid [rep-wav2vec2]. In the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29), it was tested on 10,334 sites under the joint condition. Its best layer was layer 9 on every span, with balanced accuracy of 0.616–0.625, and it scored ahead of MFCC on every span (C5) [rep-wav2vec2]. The rows also caution that its index 0 is not the CNN output but LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), so it carries position information [rep-wav2vec2].

One caveat: the rows do not state which registration revision they come from. This answer assumes they are the revision 3 specification you asked about.
